build_TransformerModel: build a TransformerModel encoder or decoder with configurable heads, layers, and embedding dimensions
run_MultiHeadAttention_forward: run the MultiHeadAttention forward pass with self-attention or cross-attention over source sentence
generate_TransformerModel_generate: generate decoded sentences from encoder representations using greedy or sampled decoding
generate_TransformerModel_generate_beam: generate decoded sentences using beam search with configurable beam size and length penalty
create_get_masks: create attention masks and hidden state masks for causal or non-causal transformer attention
